LanguageData.TheMarkedMen_CuredRefugee_LetterBody: {0} has been cured of the Marked Virus. They are no longer infected and have regained their humanity.\n\nThey are reaching out to your colony, hoping to start a new life free from the curse that consumed them. Will you offer them sanctuary?
LanguageData.TheMarkedMen_CuredRefugee_Backstory: Before their infection, {0} was living a life we can barely imagine. Now, miraculously, they have been given a second chance.
LanguageData.TheMarkedMen_CuredRefugee_HealthStatus: Their physical health is at {0}% - they are recovering from the ordeal of infection and cure.
LanguageData.TheMarkedMen_CuredRefugee_RequestToJoin: They humbly ask if they might join your colony and contribute to rebuilding their life.
LanguageData.TheMarkedMen_CuredRefugee_Reject: Turn them away - they must find their own path
LanguageData.TheMarkedMen_MessageRefugeeAccepted: {0} has been accepted into the colony and is ready to contribute.
LanguageData.TheMarkedMen_MessageRefugeeRejected: {0} has been turned away and is leaving to find sanctuary elsewhere.
